nodes.label: v0.8.0 asynchronous storage authority
nodes.description: Historical source passage (v0.8.0 architecture): A verified picker reveal retains its choice handoff while its fresh expanded state remains present; replanning cannot substitute its search field. Explicit following tasks can advance after the requested reveal. A closed picker requires fresh planning. Durable memory runs in a separate, bounded background queue, coalescing ordinary observations while retaining distinct verified edges. Live planning and sidebar polls read cached committed knowledge rather than waiting for storage. Stalled IndexedDB transactions abort after five seconds, preserving previous knowledge. Forget/Clear and route deletion discard pending writes and drain the current writer before deletion, including optional backend mirroring. Derived embedding/index writes use the same background scheduling policy. A cache read that exceeds 200 ms falls back to CPU computation and briefly bypasses the unavailable cache; persistence cannot become an inference prerequisite. Worker errors and a 30-second request deadline settle outstanding calls and replace the worker rather than leaving Chrome message ports pending. Such errors never count as task completion.
